notes.title: Spy 1 Lovecraftian- Steam Release Celebration!
notes.content:
Hold on to your textbooks (and your sanity), because the [b]Spy 1 Lovecraftian[/b] release is out now! Picture this: a high school trip to a mysterious island until tentacled beings whisper the darkest secrets of reality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868254/456e45dc63b99f071ee2bb45d9e5a750202d3af5.jpg[/img]

Join us on Steam as we celebrate the release of this heart-pounding, gut-wrenching, and surprisingly hilarious visual novel! Whether you're here for the romance, the cosmic horror, or the sheer absurdity of it all, we promise you’ll be hooked—if you can survive the madness!

Make sure to pack your courage, and maybe some snacks, because the real horror is that no one packed lunch.

notes.title: Next Fest Live Stream With the Dev
notes.content:
GoatDragonStudio here, bringing you a top-secret announcement. 
Our visual novel, [b]Spy 1 Lovecraftian[/b], is going undercover at the Steam June Festival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868254/a28ad81644a4016807fc696d36294f46cda45e68.jpg[/img]

That's right, [b]agents[/b]; we'll be infiltrating the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] with a [b]live-streamed[/b] playthrough of our latest demo. Join us on this covert operation as we showcase the thrilling adventures of [b]Billy Hayward[/b] and his telepath partner, [b]Alice Tenderwood[/b].

But be warned, this mission is not for the faint of heart - we're taking on a cult and their dark rituals head-on. So, gear up, keep your wits about you, and tune in for a night of espionage and otherworldly thrills. Remember,[b] wishlisting[/b] and [b]following[/b] are crucial for your mission preparation. Ask any questions, but be cautious - loose lips sink ships. Let's make this operation a success, [b]agents[/b].

notes.title: Next Fest Live Stream With the Dev
notes.content:
Get ready for a wild ride with GoatDragonStudio as we bring you the thrilling news about our upcoming visual novel, [b]Spy 1 Lovecraftian[/b]! 

We are ecstatic to announce that our game will be showcased during the Steam June Festival! It's a perfect opportunity for you to join us on this spooky yet exciting journey. During the Steam Next Fest, we'll be live-streaming a playthrough of the latest demo, and we promise it'll be a blast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868254/a28ad81644a4016807fc696d36294f46cda45e68.jpg[/img]

Get cozy and join us on this adventure as we explore the mysterious and thrilling world of 'Spy 1 Lovecraftian'. With a unique blend of [b]Spy x Family[/b] vibes and [b]Lovecraftian[/b] horror, you're in for an unforgettable experience. Ask us anything, wishlist, and follow us to stay updated and be a part of this fantastic festival! Let's make some festival memories together!
